name: taiwan-moto-auction-intelligence
description: Evidence-preserving open-source intelligence for Taiwanese public motorcycle auctions

scripts.db:verify: pnpm db:start && pnpm db:reset && pnpm db:test
scripts.ingest:shwoo: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source shwoo
scripts.ingest:pcc: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source pcc
scripts.ingest:judicial: docker compose run --rm ingest reprocess --source judicial
scripts.ingest:moj-auction: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source moj_auction
scripts.ingest:moj-enforcement: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source moj_enforcement --manifest /data/moj-enforcement-manifest.json
scripts.ingest:customs: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source customs
scripts.ingest:moj-enforcement-cms: docker compose run --rm ingest sync --source moj_enforcement_cms
scripts.ingest:health: docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source shwoo && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source moj_auction && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source pcc && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source customs && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source moj_enforcement_cms && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source judicial && docker compose run --rm ingest healthcheck --source moj_enforcement
scripts.retention:preview: docker compose run --rm ingest retention --source shwoo
scripts.ingest:reprocess: docker compose run --rm ingest reprocess --source shwoo
